sbn10y.note: 10-year benchmark series FR0111: yield won at the government SUN auction of 10 Nov 2026 (primary market, not a secondary-market quote). Only two decimals are published in the news; Bloomberg Technoz reports 7.67% for the same auction (rounding). The DJPPR release page is not retrievable from this server (JavaScript-rendered; not bypassed). Previous: 7.54971% at the 27 Oct 2026 auction. Updated after each SUN auction (every two weeks).
